label: Google Cloud
description: Google Cloud service account keys (JSON), Google API keys (AIza), and the standard variable names.

signals.reason: A service account key (JSON) does not expire. It acts with the roles of the service account.
A Google API key (AIza) calls the APIs that its project enables. Key restrictions in the console limit it.
The variable name names Google Cloud.
The item name or a label names Google Cloud.
A host of the item is a Google API host (googleapis.com).
